name: gui_launch
title: Launch Application
description: Launches an allowlisted GUI application or developer editor in the active interactive user session through the HHC broker. Use gui_launch for browser/desktop GUI intent; do not use shell_exec, cmd/start, or Session 0 workarounds for interactive GUI. Use HHC browser tools instead when the goal is automated web interaction.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

application.description: Application to launch in the user session (allowlisted).

target.description: Optional document, URL, or path opened by the application.

username.description: Target interactive username; omit to use the active console session.
